MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb
WITH collect(DISTINCT {k:a.issueKey,p:pa.projectKey,l:r.linkId}) + collect(DISTINCT {k:b.issueKey,p:pb.projectKey,l:r.linkId}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS x
WITH x.p AS id, count(DISTINCT x.k) AS value ORDER BY value DESC
RETURN id, value

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb AND (pa.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'] OR pb.projectKey IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM'])
UNWIND [a.issueKey,b.issueKey] AS issue
RETURN DISTINCT issue, r.linkId AS link, pa.projectKey AS project

MATCH (a:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL
MATCH (a)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pa:Project),(b)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pb:Project)
WHERE pa<>pb
UNWIND [pa.projectKey,pb.projectKey] AS p
WITH p, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p=pa.projectKey THEN a.issueKey ELSE b.issueKey END) AS value
WHERE p IN ['FE','CRUC','JRASERVER','CWD','BAM']
RETURN p AS id, value ORDER BY value DESC
